verdict.rationale: RUN Powered by ADP is a payroll SaaS rather than an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question for it. The evidence documents only API Central REST APIs with OAuth and an llms.txt file. Neither is an MCP server, and both are adjacent developer building blocks that earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
